label: Helion Energy Valuation (Series G, Jun 2026)
deltaNote: June 4, 2026: $465M Series G led by Thrive Capital (Josh Kushner) with Alta Park, Lux Capital, Peak XV, SoftBank, Sam Altman. Valuation: $15.5B (up from $5.43B). Total capital: $1.5B. Orion commercial plant under construction in Malaga, WA for Microsoft 2028 delivery.

label: NIF Record Fusion Yield
deltaNote: Feb 2024 shot: 5.2 MJ output from 2.2 MJ laser input. EYC laser upgrade (2.2→2.6 MJ) cleared Critical Decision-1 on April 24, 2026; upgrade targets significantly higher yields when operational in the late 2020s.

label: ITER Assembly Progress
contestNote: ITER Baseline 2024 revised first plasma to 2033; assembly slowed by vacuum vessel dimensional defects and thermal shield stress corrosion cracks. On May 5, 2026, DG Barabaschi declared ITER is now on budget and on schedule — the first such declaration in project history. US central solenoid final deliveries confirmed at Cadarache.

label: Total Private Fusion Capital Raised
deltaNote: FIA 2025 baseline: $9.8B. New 2026 raises: Helion +$465M Series G (Jun 4); Focused Energy +$240M Series A (May 27); Thea Energy +$100M Series B (May 27). Rolling 12-month rate: ~$1.6B (Apr 2026), down from $2.64B peak (Jul 2025).

label: KSTAR Plasma Duration Record
deltaNote: Achieved April 2024 with upgraded tungsten divertors; goal is 300 seconds by 2026

label: EAST Sustained Plasma Record
deltaNote: January 20, 2025 at 100M°C; longest sustained H-mode plasma in history

label: Active Private Fusion Companies
deltaNote: 25 in USA; 35 of 45 surveyed forecast commercially viable pilot plants by 2030–2035

label: ITER First Plasma Target
contestNote: Original target was 2025; revised to 2033 (first plasma) and 2039 (D-T burning plasma). Budget grew from ~€5B (2006) to €20B+ (2024).

label: CFS HTS Magnet Field Strength
delta: World record for large-scale HTS magnet
deltaNote: Achieved September 5, 2021 using 267 km of YBCO tape; enables compact SPARC tokamak design. SPARC ~75% complete; first plasma targeted 2027.

label: Fusion Grid Application
deltaNote: CFS filed the first-ever fusion energy company application to PJM Interconnection (the largest US wholesale electricity market, 65M+ customers) on April 28, 2026 — a landmark commercial milestone.
